name: WHU - Otto Beisheim School of Management
summary: Private business school in the small Rhine town of Vallendar, near Koblenz; one 3-year BSc with small classes, two internships and a term abroad.

ib.text: An IB Diploma qualifies ("e.g., IB"); no points minimum is published and you apply on predicted grades. WHU selects by its own analytical test, an online assessment and interviews.

dates.label: Round 1 written test and online assessment (20–21 Feb); interviews 12–14 Mar
Round 2 written test and online assessment (17–18 Apr); interviews 7–9 May
Round 3 written test and online assessment (29–30 May); interviews 19–20 Jun
Proof of 6-week internship (provisional confirmation accepted) and English test result due

programmes.name: Bachelor in International Business Administration
programmes.about: A three-year business degree in Vallendar, in English or German/English, with two internships (at least one abroad), a semester at a partner school, and a concentration from semester 4 such as entrepreneurship or business law.
programmes.ib: English track. TOEFL iBT 95, IELTS 7.0 or C1 Advanced (C) by 15 May 2027; only a fully English-taught school exempts you, not English as a subject. 6-week internship first.
programmes.selectionNote: Grades screen you in (very good grades guarantee a final-round place); then an online analytical test, a presentation and personality/motivation assessment, and 1:1 interviews.

notes: The application fee is €75 from 1 February to 31 March 2027 (with a voucher code) and €150 from 1 April to 15 May 2027.
A WHU Global IB Scholarship covers 20% of tuition for top IB graduates of any nationality.
You need a 6-week business internship, finished before the programme starts; proof (or a provisional confirmation) is due 15 May 2027, with your English test result.
